title: Invocation Response
description: The External Invocation Adapter's outbound public contract, introduced in DC-003-I010. Never exposes internal exceptions, stack traces, provider responses, API keys, transport details, raw ValidationErrors, or internal module names — see README 'Error mapping'.

accepted.description: Whether the request passed validation and was handed to the Pipeline Orchestrator — distinct from whether execution itself succeeded (see status).

request_id.description: Echoed from the request, unchanged. Null only when the inbound request was so malformed that no usable request_id could even be extracted.

execution_id.description: Null when accepted is false — no execution ever started, so no execution_id was ever allocated. Never substituted for request_id, or vice versa.

finished_carousel.description: The pipeline's own Finished Carousel Object (DC-003-I007), passed through unchanged when status is completed — already this platform's public, provider-independent contract, so no further translation happens here.
